purpose: Open the first genuinely branching physical-composition frontier left by v8.1. Replace the 18-state terminal description of the explicit smooth twisted wire by its exact six-dangling-colour boundary normal form, expose one Boolean switch bit q, and classify the smallest source-open cross-wire splice gadgets on q. Show exact source-open EQ, implication and 3-OR carriers, prove that 3-OR needs at least five splice edges in the direct three-wire matching language, and isolate the remaining composition bottleneck: every direct three-edge q-EQ copy consumes two unavoidable critical ports on each wire, so direct EQ cannot fan out twice from one six-port wire.

six_boundary_colour_normal_form.pattern_counts: Each pattern orbit has six colour assignments under S3, for exactly twelve six-boundary assignments total.
six_boundary_colour_normal_form.deterministic_left_to_right_map: Writing the left triple as (a,b,c)=(L0,L2,L3), the right triple is (R0,R2,R3)=(b,-a-b,-a+b+c) over GF(3).
six_boundary_colour_normal_form.left_domain: a!=c and b!=c; these two inequalities define exactly the twelve left boundary states and the matrix preserves this domain.

difference_coordinate_form.definition: Let c=L3, u=L0-L3 and v=L2-L3. The domain is u,v in {+1,-1} subset GF(3). Write u=s and v=s*q with s,q in {+1,-1}.
difference_coordinate_form.boolean_switch: q=+1 iff L0=L2 (pattern A); q=-1 iff L0!=L2 (pattern B). The sign s records the orientation of the two nonzero colour differences.
difference_coordinate_form.wire_transfer_on_terminal_coordinates: (c,s,q) -> (c+s*(q-1), s, q). Thus q and s are invariants of the open wire, while c is translated only in the q=-1 branch.
difference_coordinate_form.interpretation: Physical partial splices are ordinary NEQ_3 tests between selected affine colour observations c+offset(s,q). The Boolean control q is not an approximation: it is an exact quotient coordinate of the six-boundary relation.

direct_two_wire_three_splice_classificat.model: Take two open wires A,B. Add exactly three cross-wire Hamiltonian splice edges forming a matching on their dangling vertices and reject any choice creating a closed H component. Project existentially over c_A,s_A,c_B,s_B and retain only (q_A,q_B).
direct_two_wire_three_splice_classificat.no_nontrivial_one_or_two_edge_relation: With one or two cross-wire splice edges the q-projection is always FULL_2x2. Three is the first direct Boolean interaction size.

direct_eq_capacity_barrier.theorem: Every direct source-open three-splice q-EQ gadget consumes L0 and R2 on each participating wire. Therefore no single six-dangling-port wire can participate in two disjoint direct q-EQ gadgets: the two copies would collide on both critical ports.
direct_eq_capacity_barrier.scope: This blocks only fan-out by two direct two-wire EQ gadgets. It does not exclude a larger auxiliary copy/fan-out construction using implications or additional wires.

source_open_three_OR.exact_q_relation: All eight assignments except (qA,qB,qC)=(+1,+1,+1). Under the truth encoding this is exactly OR_3(A,B,C).
source_open_three_OR.H_topology: The three wires contribute nine internal open H paths. After the five splices the kept H subgraph is a forest of four open paths with eight dangling endpoints; no internal Hamiltonian cycle is created.

minimality_in_direct_three_wire_matching.conclusion: Five cross-wire splice edges are the first achieved and, by exhaustive replay through k<=4, the minimum possible size for OR_3, reverse-OR_3 or NAE_3 in this direct three-wire matching model.

main_theorem.name: PARTIAL_SPLICES_EXPOSE_AN_EXACT_BOOLEAN_SWITCH_LAYER_WITH_EQ_IMP_AND_SOURCE_OPEN_OR3
main_theorem.statement: The explicit smooth twisted wire has an exact (c,s,q) boundary normal form with one Boolean invariant q. Source-open physical splice matchings pp-define q equality, directed implication and a five-edge OR_3 relation. However the direct equality primitive has a strict six-port capacity bottleneck preventing two-way direct EQ fan-out from one wire.
proof: Enumerate the exact 18 full terminal states of the v7.9 control, project to the six dangling vertex colours and quotient duplicates. Exactly twelve assignments remain, forming the two displayed S3-orbits.
Solve the unique affine GF(3) map from the left triple to the right triple and verify M^3=I on the whole ambient vector space and preservation of the twelve-state inequality domain.
Rewrite with u=a-c and v=b-c; nonzeroness gives u,v in {+1,-1}, hence u=s, v=s*q and the displayed boundary formulas follow by substitution.

Exhaust all source-open three-edge matchings between two wires and all local (c,s,q) states. Exactly four q-relations occur with counts 24,168,168,1752, including the explicit EQ and implication controls.
Inspect all 24 EQ matchings: on either endpoint the used port set is exactly one of two triples and both contain L0,R2, proving the direct fan-out collision theorem.

For three wires, exhaust every source-open matching with one through four cross-wire splice edges. None projects to OR_3, its complement-polarity reverse OR, or NAE_3. The displayed five-edge forest is replayed directly and projects to all Boolean triples except all-FALSE.

positive: Replaces the partial-splice 18-state search by a transparent GF(3) base colour c plus two signs s,q; q is the exact Boolean branch variable.
Finds the first explicit source-open ternary Boolean clause atom in this branch: OR_3.
Finds exact source-open q-EQ and implication primitives and pinpoints why the obvious EQ-copy network cannot branch.
firewall: OR_3 plus one non-composable EQ witness is not yet a source-preserving NP-hardness reduction. Variable reuse/fan-out must be realized within the six-port Hamiltonian budget before any hardness promotion.
The five-edge OR minimality statement is scoped to three copies of this explicit wire, cross-wire matching edges only, and the no-internal-H-cycle source-open gate.
No result here constructs a polynomial solver for the partial-splice language; conversely no P=NP conclusion follows from finding the Boolean atoms.

next_target.name: E8_BOOLEAN_Q_COMPOSABLE_FANOUT_OR_CAPACITY_INVARIANT_V8_3
next_target.directive: Do not repeat direct EQ search: its critical-port collision is complete. Use the 168 implication gadgets, whose endpoint port triples are much more diverse, to search for a source-open copy/fan-out network q_parent=q_child1=q_child2 or an equivalent variable-consistency backbone with no wire exceeding its six dangling ports. In parallel test auxiliary-wire EQ gadgets with terminal port load <=2; if impossible, extract an observational/cut invariant rather than treating finite failure as universal. Any hardness claim must include an explicit Hamiltonian-open composition scheme connecting variable consistency gadgets to the five-edge OR_3 atom.
